newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Dabur in tie up with Liberty International.
newsitem.headline: India's Dabur in tie up with Liberty International.

text.p: India's Dabur group entered into a tie-up with Liberty International Holding Inc of the U.S. to set up a joint venture in the general insurance sector, a company official said on Wednesday.
The two companies have signed an agremeent to provide insurance cover in the field of general insurance, a company official told reporters.
"Dabur's experience of the Indian market and Liberty's expertise in insurance will be an ideal combination for this joint venture," A.C. Burman, Chairman of Dabur, said.
Dabur, whose flagship is Dabur India Ltd, is a 5.61-billion-rupee ($156.70 million) Indian ethnic healthcare and herbal product giant with a wide distribution network.
"With our experince in health care and extensive distribution network we feel we can make a contribution to India's insurance", Burman said.

Liberty International Holding Inc is a diversified financial services company, a part of the Boston-based Liberty Mutual group, which has more than $37 billion in consolidated assets and more than $42 billion in assets under management.
India began liberalising trade, industry and banking in 1991 as part of a sweeping programme to dismantle decades of socialist controls.
But so far the insurance sector has not been opened to private enterprise and all Indian insurance companies are state-owned.

"We feel the government is working hard to provide a solid insurance industry and we would like a level playing field once the sector is thrown open to the private sector," said Ralph B. Hurlbutt, director India project, Liberty international.
Industry officials say the value of India's insurance industry is about 150 billion rupees ($4.4 bln) and the sector is growing at the rate of about 11 percent per year.
About 22 foreign firms from the U.S., Canada, Switzerland, Germany, the Middle East and Japan plan to enter the Indian insurance market, insurance sector officials said recently.
